Physical Therapy

Carly Stote, Doctor of Physical Therapy, runs her own practice, Strength and Sports Physical Therapy & Recovery Center, in the PT room at the back of CrossFit Southie.

What To Expect

Personalized, one-on-one physical therapy focused on relieving pain, restoring movement and getting you back to the activities and sports you love.

Treatments

Dry needling, Graston, cupping, soft tissue massage, active release techniques and joint mobilizations.

Insurance

The practice accepts most insurances and also offers cash-based services and bodywork recovery options.
